note: Deterministic rule table for tools/strategy_farm/research/second_chance_register.py. Classifies every REJECTED / RETIRED / DRAFT / policy-blocked strategy record into ONE primary reason from the directive-24 enum. Rules are applied in ascending 'precedence' order; the FIRST rule whose match fires sets the primary reason. Lower precedence number = higher priority. Nothing is guessed: a record whose signals match no rule is OTHER. All matching is on lower-cased text; 'match_any' = OR of substrings.

eligibility_rationale.superseded_style_or_policy: Directive 16 (no external source required), 17 (style is not a rejection reason), 18-21 (martingale/grid/pyramiding/multi-position testable under bounded-risk), 30 (activity/economic selection thresholds may be reviewed). Records rejected only for these become second-chance candidates.
eligibility_rationale.ML_RUNTIME: HR14 / directive 15 unchanged: runtime ML in the EA decision engine stays prohibited. STILL_INVALID.
eligibility_rationale.ECONOMIC_FAIL: A measured economic failure stays invalid unless the directive-27 counterfactual shows positive out-of-sample portfolio utility, in which case the record is additionally flagged PORTFOLIO_UTILITY_CHALLENGER (directive 28).
eligibility_rationale.INFRA_FAIL: An infrastructure / operational failure never judged the strategy; eligible for a clean rerun as NEW lineage.
eligibility_rationale.DUPLICATE: A clone / functional duplicate is not worth factory time (directive 25) unless lineage says materially different.
eligibility_rationale.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: The card never carried a testable mechanical spec, symbols, period, or the required DWX-testable data. It needs a repaired/complete card (fresh intake), not a retest of the old record.

reason_text_rules.note: Runtime ML in the trading engine (HR14). Distinct from the HR14 one-position-per-magic convention, which is MULTI_POSITION.

A measured pipeline / portfolio economic failure recorded on the record's own current_blocker or terminal_verdict. Ranks above stale G0 card notes because the pipeline verdict is the operative reason a record that reached the pipeline is now blocked (an approved card carries no style rejection).
A pipeline invalidity / build fault on the record's own blocker: operational, rerunnable, never an economic judgement.
Explicit duplicate / clone rejection text. Eligibility upgraded only if lineage carries a materially_different edge.
Directive 18: not automatically prohibited; testable under a deterministic tail-risk contract.
Directive 17/18: bounded grid/recovery testable under a tail-risk contract.
Directive 21: positive and negative pyramiding both allowed as distinct mechanisms; tail-risk contract required.
Directive 17/20: multiple simultaneous positions, basket management, partial exits are explicitly allowed. Old HR14 one-position-per-magic rejections are superseded by portfolio-level risk control.
Directive 17: scalping / high-frequency-enough mechanical intraday trading is an allowed family.
Directive 22: no arbitrary 'max N filters' rule as a Hard Rule unless evidence supports it.

Explicit superseded-source marker (a source-only rejection later recovered under the OWNER R1 policy). Ranks above the generic insufficient-evidence rule so the operative reason is the superseded source requirement, not the residual spec text.

match_any: cannot be tested on a complete dwx
reason_text_rules.note: The card never carried a testable/complete mechanical spec or the required DWX-testable data. Needs a repaired card (fresh intake), not a retest.
Directive 16: no external source required. Provenance still required, so an accepted record needs a QM-RESEARCH id, but the original 'uncited / no track record' rejection is superseded.

Activity / cadence / frequency floor and OWNER D1 dispositions. Directive 27/30: activity and low-frequency thresholds may be too strict and are reviewable; low-frequency records may still be valuable portfolio components.

verdict_class_rules.note: A measured economic / portfolio failure from work_items.
Infrastructure failure only; the strategy was never economically judged.
Build/artifact/evidence invalidity is an operational (rerunnable) fault, not an economic verdict.

registry_reason_rules.note: Empty ID reservation that never carried a strategy spec. Administratively retired; there is nothing to reconsider without a fresh card.
OWNER D1 drain disposition RETIRE. Reason is drawn from the underlying rejected card when one exists; otherwise a policy retirement.

hold_code_rules.note: Resource / RAM head-of-line block. Rerunnable once scheduling improves (directive 12/G).

scoring.note: Priority (directive 26) = 100 * weighted-sum of components in [0,1], minus tail_penalty. FTMO relevance and expected edge are weighted highest (directive 26/31: FTMO is the larger business gap). Only ELIGIBLE_FOR_RECONSIDERATION and PORTFOLIO_UTILITY_CHALLENGER records are ranked; STILL_INVALID and SUPPRESSED_CLONE_OF records are scored for completeness but excluded from the ranked list.
